reported.label: Revenue ₹73,188 crore, +1.3% QoQ
reported.quote: Our quarterly revenue was ₹73,188 crore, a growth of 1.3% sequentially and 11.2% on a year-on-year basis.

reported.label: Operating margin stable at 24%
reported.quote: Our operating margins remained stable sequentially at 24%.

reported.label: Net margin 19%
reported.quote: Our net margins for the quarter were 19%.

reported.label: TCV $9.6 billion
reported.quote: TCV for the quarter was US$9.6 billion. This excludes the Porsche and Best Buy deals.

reported.label: Annualized AI revenue $3.1 billion, >10% of revenue
reported.quote: Annualized AI revenue reached $3.1 billion and crossed 10% of our overall revenue.

reported.label: Constant currency growth +0.5% QoQ, +2.8% YoY
reported.quote: In constant currency terms, our growth was 50 basis points QoQ and 2.8% YoY.

reported.label: Attrition 13.3%, down 30bps
reported.quote: LTM attrition in IT services reduced by 30 basis points sequentially to 13.3%.

reported.label: Cash conversion 102.2%, funds $5.98 billion
reported.quote: Our cash conversion remains strong at 102.2% of net income and funds invested at the end of the period stood at $5.98 billion.
